Title: Azure Functions support for PowerShell 6 is ending on 30 September 2022

Body.Content:
Because PowerShell 6 has reached end of support on 4 September 2020, applications hosted on Azure Functions using PowerShell 6 will be unsupported after 30 September 2022.

Required action

To avoid any service disruption and potential security vulnerabilities in your applications, we recommend you  upgrade to PowerShell 7, and then follow the steps to update your applications settings before 30 September 2022.

Help and support

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
